name: robust
expr: [b_r, s_r] = robustfit(X, y); err_r = abs(b_r(1) - 2.0); [b_h, s_h] = robustfit(X, y, 'huber'); err_h = abs(b_h(1) - 2.0); [sig_r, mu_r] = robustcov(Xn); diag1 = sig_r(1, 1); diag2 = sig_r(2, 2);
comment: Sig: [b, s] = robustfit(X, y [, wfun [, tune]]) — IRLS robust regression with bisquare (default, tune=4.685) or huber (tune=1.345). KNOWN GAP: stats struct (DOF, p-values, etc.) reduced to scalar s. [sigma, mu] = robustcov(X) — trimmed-MCD robust covariance via h = ceil(0.75 · n) concentration steps with Pison-Van Aelst-Willems consistency correction. KNOWN GAPs: full FAST-MCD multi-start, MVE method, OGK estimator not in v1. Spec uses deterministic sin/cos noise to make parity reproducible across engines; pins error bounds and shape invariants.
